trigger.diagnosis: Maximum speculative batches consumed finite real pool capacity for signatures that had not proved reuse.

reuse.deja_query: E133 adaptive descriptor lease prefetch cold signature pool exhaustion hot signature growth
local_contracts: E132 exact live pool/layout signatures and atomic capacity fallback

implementation.growth_evidence: A later live miss grows a signature only when its published bank cursor equals its count, proving every prior extra was claimed.
implementation.capacity_fallback: OUT_OF_POOL_MEMORY or FRAGMENTED_POOL halves whole-signature repetitions; if no useful extra fits, exact allocation remains authoritative and batching is disabled until reset.

correctness.native_authority: Every returned or published descriptor-set ID comes from a successful real native allocation.
correctness.cold_capacity_bound: An unseen one-set signature consumes at most one unused speculative set instead of fifteen.
correctness.reset: Successful reset disables every pool bank and restores cold state without performing any speculative native allocation.
correctness.destroy: Pool destruction disables and forgets every signature plan.
correctness.journal: Pending journal bytes force the ordered real transaction and cannot consume a local lease out of order.

validation.adaptive_signature: The fake-native cross-process path proves batch 2 followed by one hit, batch 4 followed by three hits, then batch 8 followed by seven hits.
validation.coexisting_signature: A second live signature independently starts at batch 2 and then hits locally.
validation.reset: The first post-reset request is a live ring miss and batch 2; only the following request is a local hit.
validation.small_pool: A two-set DXVK-shaped pool accepts the cold batch; a pending journal then forces exact allocation. A one-set pool rejects batch 2 and succeeds through exact fallback.
validation.profile: Worker output includes batch_growths in addition to attempts, successes, extras, and fallbacks.

next_gate: Build and deploy the exact tablet pair transactionally, then rerun the native-resolution Tomb Raider visible-frame and game-authored benchmark gate with screenshot inspection.
